data.name: Negative Pregnancy Test Requirement
data.description: Female patients of childbearing potential must have a negative urine or serum pregnancy test within 7 days prior to Cycle 1 Day 1
data.text: Negative urine or serum pregnancy test within 7 days prior to Cycle 1 Day 1

data.name: Contraception Compliance - Female
data.description: FOCBP must use two forms of effective contraception, at least one highly effective (less than 1% failure rate), during trial and for at least 3 months after last dose
data.text: Two forms of effective contraception required, where at least one is highly effective (less than 1% failure rate), including combination oral contraceptives, implanted contraceptives, or intrauterine devices

data.name: Contraception Compliance - Male
data.description: Males with nonpregnant FOCBP partners must use condoms plus one additional highly effective method for duration of study and up to 3 months after last dose
data.text: Condom plus one additional highly effective contraceptive method (less than 1% failure rate) required for study duration and 3 months post last dose

data.name: Treatment Compliance Threshold
data.description: Patient must take at least 80% of prescribed medication to be considered compliant unless otherwise specified in addendum
data.text: Compliance threshold is at least 80% of prescribed medication unless otherwise specified in Section 3.6.5 of the enrolled addendum

data.name: Re-screening Permission Requirement
data.description: Screen failures may only be re-screened after discussion with and permission from Lilly CRP/CRS or designee
data.text: Re-screening only permitted after discussion with and permission from Lilly CRP/CRS or designee

data.name: Laboratory Test Repeat Limit During Screening
data.description: Screening laboratory tests may not be repeated more than twice to meet eligibility during the screening period
data.text: Screening laboratory tests may not be repeated more than twice in order to meet eligibility during the screening period

data.name: Continued Access Clinical Benefit Requirement
data.description: Patients may continue to receive study treatment during continued access period only if experiencing clinical benefit and no undue risks
data.text: Patients on study treatment may continue if experiencing clinical benefit and no undue risks after final analysis and Lilly declaration of continued access period

data.name: Inadvertent Enrollment Continuation Criteria
data.description: Inadvertently enrolled patients may continue only if both Lilly CRP/CRS and investigator agree it is medically appropriate, with documented approval
data.text: Both Lilly CRP/CRS and investigator must agree it is medically appropriate to continue; documented approval from Lilly CRP/CRS required

data.name: Adaptive Randomization Rules

data.text: Adaptive treatment randomization methodology and adaptation rules will be described in the applicable addendum

data.text: Long-term follow-up during the study treatment period does not apply during the continued access period; patients in long-term follow-up when continued access period begins will be discontinued from long-term follow-up

data.name: Screen Failure to Alternative Investigation
data.text: Individuals who do not meet criteria for participation in an individual investigation may be considered for another investigation within the CAMPFIRE Master Protocol

data.name: Study Treatment Period to Continued Access Period
data.text: After final analysis of a given investigation-specific addendum and Lilly declaration that continued access period has begun, patients still on study treatment may continue if experiencing clinical benefit and no undue risks

data.name: Continued Access Treatment to Continued Access Follow-Up
data.text: Continued access follow-up begins when patient and investigator agree to discontinue study treatment and lasts approximately 30 (±7) days

data.name: Short-Term Follow-Up Continuation into Continued Access
data.text: Patients in short-term follow-up during the study treatment period when the continued-access period begins will continue in short-term follow-up until the 30-day short-term follow-up visit is completed

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Treatment Due to Disease Progression
data.text: Patient has radiographic progressive disease or significant symptomatic disease deterioration characterized as progression of disease, in the opinion of investigator; every effort should be made to document disease progression

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Treatment Due to Unacceptable Toxicity
data.text: Patient experiences unacceptable toxicity (e.g., a persistent moderate toxicity that is intolerable to the patient)

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Treatment Due to Noncompliance
data.text: Patient is noncompliant with study procedures and/or treatment; potential discontinuation discussed between investigator and Lilly CRP/CRS before final determination

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Treatment Due to Maximum Dose Reductions
data.text: Patient has had maximum dose reductions allowed per protocol and experiences an AE that would cause an additional dose reduction

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Treatment Due to Pregnancy
data.text: Patient becomes pregnant during the study; pregnancy must be reported following the SAE process to collect data on outcome for both mother and fetus

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Treatment Due to Incompatible Study Enrollment
data.text: Patient is enrolled in any other clinical study involving an investigational product or any other type of medical research judged not to be scientifically or medically compatible with this study

data.name: Rescue Therapy Requiring Treatment Discontinuation
data.text: If the patient, for any reason, requires treatment with another therapeutic agent that has been demonstrated to be effective for treatment of the study indication, discontinuation from the study drug(s) occurs prior to introduction of the other agent

data.name: Investigator Decision to Discontinue from Study Treatment
data.text: The investigator/physician decides that the patient should be discontinued from the study or study drug(s)

data.name: Patient/Guardian Decision to Discontinue from Study Treatment
data.text: The patient or the patient's designee (e.g., parents or legal guardian) requests to be discontinued from the study or study drug

data.name: Sponsor Decision to Discontinue Patient
data.text: Lilly stops the study or stops the patient's participation in the study for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons consistent with applicable laws, regulations, and GCP

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Addendum Due to Pregnancy
data.text: Patient becomes pregnant during the specific addendum; regulatory reporting requirements on fetal outcome apply per Section 9.2.1

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Addendum - Medical/Safety/Regulatory
data.text: Participation in the study needs to be stopped for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons consistent with applicable laws, regulations, and GCP

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Addendum - Investigator Decision
data.text: The investigator decides that the patient should be discontinued from the study

data.name: Discontinuation from Study Addendum - Patient/Guardian Request
data.text: The patient requests to be discontinued from the specific addendum, or the patient's legal representative requests discontinuation

data.name: Re-enrollment into New Investigation After Screen Failure
data.text: Participating in one investigation does not preclude the patient from enrolling in another investigation within the CAMPFIRE Master Protocol at a subsequent time as long as eligibility criteria are met

data.name: Study Site Discontinuation

data.name: Full Study Discontinuation
data.text: The study will be discontinued if Lilly judges it necessary for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons consistent with applicable laws, regulations, and GCP

data.name: Early Termination - Disease Progression

data.name: Early Termination - Unacceptable Toxicity
data.description: Patient discontinued from study treatment due to unacceptable toxicity, such as persistent moderate toxicity intolerable to the patient

data.description: Patient discontinued from study treatment and/or addendum due to pregnancy; fetal outcome reporting required per SAE process

data.name: Early Termination - Noncompliance
data.description: Patient discontinued due to noncompliance with study procedures and/or treatment; threshold is less than 80% compliance unless otherwise specified

data.name: Early Termination - Incompatible Study Enrollment
data.description: Patient enrolled in another clinical study involving an investigational product or medical research judged not to be scientifically or medically compatible with this study

data.name: Early Termination - Rescue Therapy Required
data.description: Patient requires treatment with another therapeutic agent demonstrated to be effective for the study indication; discontinuation from study drug occurs prior to introduction of the other agent

data.name: Early Termination - Maximum Dose Reductions Reached
data.description: Patient has had maximum dose reductions allowed per protocol and experiences an AE requiring additional dose reduction

data.name: Early Termination - Investigator Decision
data.description: Investigator/physician decides patient should be discontinued from study or study drug

data.name: Early Termination - Patient/Guardian Decision
data.description: Patient or patient's designee (parents or legal guardian) requests discontinuation from study or study drug

data.name: Early Termination - Sponsor Decision
data.description: Lilly stops the study or stops the patient's participation for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons consistent with applicable laws, regulations, and GCP

data.name: Early Termination - Lost to Follow-Up
data.description: Patient repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site despite diligent attempts

data.name: Study Completion - Investigation Final Analysis
data.description: Completion of investigation occurs following the final analysis as defined in the applicable addenda and when determined by Lilly; investigators continue to follow investigation-specific Schedule of Activities until notified by Lilly

data.name: Continued Access Period End
data.description: Patient's continued access to study treatment ends when a criterion for discontinuation is met per Section 8; continued access follow-up lasts approximately 30 (±7) days

data.name: Protocol Deviation - Inadvertent Enrollment
data.description: Patient who did not meet enrollment criteria was inadvertently enrolled; Lilly CRP/CRS and investigator must discuss to determine if patient may continue; if not medically appropriate to continue, patient is discontinued

data.name: Study Site Closure
data.description: Study site participation discontinued if Lilly, investigator, or ERB/IRB judges it necessary for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons

data.name: Full Study Discontinuation by Sponsor
data.description: The study will be discontinued if Lilly judges it necessary for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons consistent with applicable laws, regulations, and GCP

data.name: Screen Failure Re-screening Decision
data.description: Decision point for whether a screen failure may be re-screened; requires discussion with and permission from Lilly CRP/CRS or designee; laboratory tests may not be repeated more than twice

data.name: Inadvertent Enrollment Continuation Decision
data.description: Decision point for whether an inadvertently enrolled patient may continue in the study; requires agreement between Lilly CRP/CRS and investigator that it is medically appropriate, with documented approval

data.name: Continued Access Eligibility Decision
data.description: After final analysis and Lilly declaration of continued access period, decision point for whether patients still on study treatment may continue based on clinical benefit and absence of undue risks

data.name: Noncompliance Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Decision point for potential discontinuation due to study drug noncompliance; must be discussed between investigator and Lilly CRP/CRS before final determination; threshold is at least 80% compliance

data.name: Disease Progression Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Decision point for discontinuation due to radiographic progressive disease or significant symptomatic deterioration; every effort should be made to document disease progression unless not medically appropriate

data.name: Dose Modification vs. Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Decision point when patient experiences AE requiring dose modification; if maximum dose reductions already reached, discontinuation is triggered; otherwise dose modification per addendum-specific rules applies

data.name: Long-Term Follow-Up Discontinuation at Continued Access Start
data.description: Decision point at start of continued access period: patients in long-term follow-up are discontinued from long-term follow-up; patients in short-term follow-up continue until 30-day visit is completed

data.name: Adaptive Randomization Decision
data.description: For addenda incorporating adaptive treatment randomization methodology, adaptation rules as described in the applicable addendum govern treatment allocation decisions
